rusted_ironclad_plate.name: Rusted Ironclad Plate
rusted_ironclad_plate.desc: Standard issue for the Grimstone deep-guards. The inside of the breastplate has frantic claw marks.

scouts_bone_leather.name: Scout's Bone Leather
scouts_bone_leather.desc: Treated with marrow oil from the Bone Warrens. The leather is eerily light.

ash_woven_robes.name: Ash-Woven Robes
ash_woven_robes.desc: Garments worn by the Entombed Scholars. If you listen closely, you can hear a woman apologizing.

tunnel_runners_garb.name: Tunnel Runner's Garb
tunnel_runners_garb.desc: Worn by the miners who tried to escape. They ran in the dark. The leather remembers the route.

deep_chaplains_vestment.name: Deep Chaplain's Vestment
deep_chaplains_vestment.desc: A priest was assigned to bless each shift. He stopped blessing. He started praying.

flesh_forged_cuirass.name: Flesh-Forged Cuirass
flesh_forged_cuirass.desc: Aeridorian metal fused with living sinew. It tightens when you are afraid.

deep_stalkers_hide.name: Deep Stalker's Hide
deep_stalkers_hide.desc: Skinned from a Deep Stalker. The leather still shifts color in torchlight.

the_vessels_mantle.name: The Vessel's Mantle
the_vessels_mantle.desc: A cloak of woven resonance. It was meant for the Elder who feeds the mountain.

eyeless_horrors_skin.name: Eyeless Horror's Skin
eyeless_horrors_skin.desc: It screams at a frequency only the wearer can hear. You get used to it. That's the worst part.

core_chaplains_raiment.name: Core Chaplain's Raiment
core_chaplains_raiment.desc: The last chaplain abandoned his faith on Floor 62. The robes kept praying without him.

slag_crusted_helm.name: Slag-Crusted Helm
slag_crusted_helm.desc: The visor is welded shut by centuries of forge heat. Whoever wore it last did not die from combat.

cowl_of_the_blind_leech.name: Cowl of the Blind Leech
cowl_of_the_blind_leech.desc: A hood that covers the eyes. The wearer sees nothing, but feels the pulse of every living thing.

resonance_diadem_spine.name: Crystalline Mind-Crown
resonance_diadem_spine.desc: Grown from a shard of the mountain's core. It whispers solutions to problems you haven't encountered yet.

lurking_shadows_hood.name: Lurking Shadow's Hood
lurking_shadows_hood.desc: Woven from darkness itself. The wearer's face becomes difficult to remember.

striders_of_the_abyss.name: Striders of the Abyss
striders_of_the_abyss.desc: They make absolutely no sound. The perfect boots for abandoning your friends to the dark.

pulse_walkers_treads.name: Pulse-Walker's Treads
pulse_walkers_treads.desc: Boots that step in time with the mountain's heartbeat. You cannot walk off-rhythm.

pendant_of_the_lost_scout.name: Pendant of the Lost Scout
pendant_of_the_lost_scout.desc: A silver locket containing a map back to Oakhaven. The map is crossed out. 'THEY KNOW' is scratched on the back.

resonance_warped_ring.name: Resonance-Warped Ring
resonance_warped_ring.desc: A band of crystal that absorbs light. The crystal is cracked.

lockpicks_of_the_damned.name: Lockpicks of the Damned
lockpicks_of_the_damned.desc: Shaped from the finger bones of a thief who died mid-pick. They fit every lock in the Spine.

tithe_collectors_signet.name: Tithe-Collector's Signet
tithe_collectors_signet.desc: A heavy gold ring bearing the seal of Oakhaven. It burns to the touch. The mountain expects a meal.

marrow_bite_ring.name: Marrow-Bite Ring
marrow_bite_ring.desc: The band is carved from a single tooth. It bites back if you try to remove it.

vessels_rosary.name: Vessel's Rosary
vessels_rosary.desc: Each bead is a crystallized tear from a different Oakhaven Elder. There have been many.

potion_standard.name: Health Potion
potion_standard.description: A standard restorative brew. Smells like copper and honey.

lightstone.name: Lightstone
lightstone.description: A wisp's core, still glowing. Permanent light source. Does not deplete.

phoenix_feather.name: Phoenix Feather
phoenix_feather.description: A feather of rebirth. Restores a great deal of HP.

ether.name: Ether
ether.description: A shimmering blue liquid. Restores mental clarity.

eye_drops.name: Eye Drops
eye_drops.description: Retired: blindness is not a supported character condition.

torch.name: Torch
torch.description: A simple torch. Lights the way.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: A sweet, herbal draught that neutralizes venoms.

smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smoke_bomb.description: Safely escape your own overworld encounter without spending a hunt or losing XP/Gold.

warding_salve.name: Warding Salve
warding_salve.description: Grants Fortified: +2 DEF until the next combat ends.

frenzy_draught.name: Frenzy Draught
frenzy_draught.description: Grants Embered: +2 ATK until the next combat ends.

moonwater.name: Moonwater
moonwater.description: A shimmering water collected under full moonlight. Restores all HP.

trap_kit.name: Trap Kit
trap_kit.description: Retired: dungeon trap placement is not supported.

silver_moss.name: Silvermoss
silver_moss.description: A glowing moss found near water.

silverleaf.name: Silverleaf
silverleaf.description: A rare, shimmering herb found on the Trade Road.

dire_root.name: Dire Root
dire_root.description: A tough, bitter root from deep woods.

honey_sap.name: Honey Sap
honey_sap.description: Sweet, sticky sap from ancient trees.

gilded_mushroom.name: Gilded Mushroom
gilded_mushroom.description: A rare, gold-capped mushroom. Hemlock pays well for these.

wingpost_letter.name: Wingpost Letter
wingpost_letter.description: A sealed letter addressed to 'Someone in Oakhaven'.

pearl.name: Pearl
pearl.description: A lustrous white pearl. Smooth and cold to the touch.

topaz.name: Topaz
topaz.description: A pale golden stone that catches candlelight well.

peridot.name: Peridot
peridot.description: Pale green. Found in the ruins occasionally, origin unclear.

emerald.name: Emerald
emerald.description: Deep green. Worth more than most people earn in a month.

opal.name: Opal
opal.description: Shifts color in different light. Hemlock keeps a jar of them behind the clock.

black_pearl.name: Black Pearl
black_pearl.description: A dark lustrous pearl. Rare enough that Hemlock straightens up when you show him.

fire_opal.name: Fire Opal
fire_opal.description: Burns orange and red inside. Warm to the touch in a way that doesn't make sense.

star_ruby.name: Star Ruby
star_ruby.description: A six-pointed light moves inside it when you turn it. Nobody explains why.

fire_emerald.name: Fire Emerald
fire_emerald.description: Deep green threaded with veins of red. Aeridorian resonance does strange things to gems.

sapphire.name: Sapphire
sapphire.description: Clear blue. This belonged to someone important once. They aren't around anymore.

ruby.name: Ruby
ruby.description: Blood red. The deep ruins produce them occasionally. Nobody asks how.

jacinth.name: Jacinth
jacinth.description: Orange-red. The Aeridorian archives describe it as a focusing stone. For what, they don't say.

black_sapphire.name: Black Sapphire
black_sapphire.description: Deep black with a blue core. The light inside moves on its own. Don't stare.

diamond.name: Diamond
diamond.description: Flawless. Heavy. Elara wouldn't say where the one on her desk came from.

blue_diamond.name: Blue Diamond
blue_diamond.description: The rarest thing you'll find in the ruins. The light inside it doesn't come from outside.

shift_log_page.name: Shift Log Page
shift_log_page.description: Day 247. Something answers when we tap the lower wall.

burial_offering.name: Burial Offering
burial_offering.description: An offering from a civilization without a name. The material is unclassified.

forge_manifest.name: Forge Manifest
forge_manifest.description: A production order. 50,000 units. Delivery: Aeridor Central. Status: Pending. Date: 600 years ago.

deep_fragment.name: Deep Fragment
deep_fragment.description: Crystallized void. Elara won't touch it. Hemlock will buy it without asking questions.

mountain_shard.name: Mountain Shard
mountain_shard.description: The mountain is aware you took this. It is not pleased but it does not pursue small grievances.

spine_memory.name: Spine Memory
spine_memory.description: A compressed memory of the Aeridorian collapse, from the mountain's perspective. It is not flattering to anyone.

stolen_trade_crate.name: Stolen Trade Crate
stolen_trade_crate.description: A heavy wooden crate recovered from the Whisperwood Blockade. Contains seized goods and coins.

potion.name: Health Potion
potion.description: A standard restorative brew. Smells like copper and honey.

hi_potion_brew.name: Greater Potion
hi_potion_brew.description: A stronger restorative — the moss stabilizes the thistle's potency.

elixir_brew.name: Elixir
elixir_brew.description: A deep green draught. The Silverleaf's shimmer fades as the root absorbs it.

xp_tonic.name: Experience Tonic
xp_tonic.description: The emerald dissolves into a luminous green liquid. Sharpens the mind.

hunters_draught.name: Hunter's Draught
hunters_draught.description: A bitter amber tonic. The topaz dust settles into an oily film that smells like pine.

ironbark_tonic.name: Ironbark Tonic
ironbark_tonic.description: The root hardens as it absorbs the pearl's essence. Skin toughens on contact.

firebrew.name: Firebrew
firebrew.description: The opal cracks and bleeds fire into the brew. Handle with care.

phoenix_brew.name: Phoenix Brew
phoenix_brew.description: The star ruby ignites the silverleaf. It burns without consuming. Life from flames.

smoke_bomb.name: Smoke Bomb
smoke_bomb.description: Safely escape your own overworld encounter without spending a hunt or losing XP/Gold.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: A sweet, herbal draught that neutralizes venoms.

warding_salve.name: Warding Salve
warding_salve.description: Grants Fortified: +2 DEF until the next combat ends.

frenzy_draught.name: Frenzy Draught
frenzy_draught.description: Grants Embered: +2 ATK until the next combat ends.

moonwater.name: Moonwater
moonwater.description: A shimmering water collected under full moonlight. Restores all HP.
